name: dioscorea villosa root
purpose: 1. Helps regulate hormone levels, relieve menopausal symptoms and reduce premenstrual syndrome. 2. Reduce mood swings and anxiety and improve quality of life. 3. Promote deep sleep, relieve fatigue and reduce insomnia.
uses: After cleansing and drying skin, apply appropriate amount to palms. Gently massage belly, chest, arms and inner thighs until completely absorbed. It is recommended for menstruating women to start using it one week before menstruation, twice daily until the end of menstruation.
otcwarn: Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur. Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur.
